main_text.l: Ebn O'lwalid occupata eft. Duravis hoc regnum
De AFRICA hoc fufficiat; Omarem per
& muro cinctam, Fustatam nominasse. Cum Ma-
scuaco, ejus praefecto, pacem ea lege, ut Ægypti
pro fingulis perfonis aureum Ægyptiacum lul-
decies mille aureorum tributum folverent, sese
XXIIIM Muslimorum intra XIV menses pugna-
In HISPANIA fuere fucoeffive post Gothos
doctus, Aftures & Ruccones, qui locorum natu
furgentes, novis copiis ad veterem Sulcitanum ex-
ercitum adjectis, bis vicit; & haud paucas ipso-
rum ad fretum Gaditanum & Oceani littora
urbes in fuam potestatem redegit: tandem et
Suinthila, pater pauperum dictus, primo Valcon-
compulit; & admissos in gratiam, urbem Oli-
gitum fuis fumptibus aedificare coegit: deinde Rumas.

page.notes: Marginal notes are partly illegible in the scan; the left-margin notes are reconstructed approximately. Several words in the body are damaged and uncertain, notably in the lines around "Suinthila" and "Taraconensis"; the transcription there is doubtful. Right margin is cut off.
